verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a v2 API in which a job chains import, convert and export tasks (cloudconvert-docs-5). Task status is visible in real time through the Socket API (cloudconvert-docs-22), and official SDKs, a Job Builder and a sandbox support development (cloudconvert-docs-1, cloudconvert-docs-2, cloudconvert-docs-3). The pack's only explicit import/export example is S3, though Signed URLs let files be converted on demand via URL parameters (cloudconvert-docs-21). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of direct-upload and import-from-URL tasks, a documented export/download URL for the output file, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
